lexicon_policy: Fixed operational word lists, not contextual POS tagging. Primary uses base+extended; sensitivity base only. Unlisted words are called non-list words, not validated content words. Homographs, auxiliaries used lexically, adverbs and contractions limit linguistic interpretation.
tokenizer: Reuse v01 ASCII English tokens and apostrophe normalization; no stemming or synonym merging
exact_decomposition: For each original 50-token sliding window, MATTR = 1 - (n_function - unique_function)/50 - (n_nonlist - unique_nonlist)/50. Average components over identical windows; compare paired differences.
secondary: non-list MATTR25 after deleting function-list tokens
top five token frequencies by class
length_sensitivity: Repeat decomposition on first 100 original lexical tokens
uncertainty: Enumerate all 6^6 question bootstrap means for paired deltas, descriptive 95% percentile intervals; one persona, not population or generation-sampling uncertainty
causal_limit: Accounting decomposition and deletion sensitivity do not identify causal linguistic mechanisms or syntax/semantic coherence

qwen.role: Brief evidence-linked linguistic descriptions of 24 N0/INC3 texts, never clinical scoring
qwen.blinding: opaque IDs and hash-sorted order; generator/condition/intended stage and metric results withheld; blinding cannot prevent style inference
qwen.quote_validation: Each returned excerpt must be an exact contiguous substring; invalid excerpts flagged, no automated retries

stop_rule: Finish this fixed decomposition, control comparisons and six local annotation batches; preserve non-supportive findings; no new speech, embeddings, metrics search or clinical claims
